output:
- User collects vintage cameras and postcards; restarted collecting Aug 2023.
- 2023/08/11: Finished initial spreadsheet catalog (basic fields); declined to add extra fields (image description, message transcription, postal history, provenance) for now—plans to add details later.
- 2023/11/30: Bought 8 more postcards at a local antique shop.
- By 2023/11/30: Total collection grew to 25 new postcards since restarting (up from 17 itemized earlier); only first 3 (PC001–PC003) itemized.
- Prefers wall-mounted shelves for camera display; considering combining with glass-top display cases for smaller/rare items.
- New interest: learning film development; received resource suggestions (The Darkroom, YouTube channels, r/analogphotography, books).
- Planning to host a collector's gathering at home (trading, show-and-tell, knowledge sharing); excited about it.
- Continues buying from local antique shops; eBay also a prior source.
